headline: Fuel crisis: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman expresses regret over public suffering
summary: The PM describes the current fuel shortage as the country's biggest problem and confirms that an action plan is in place to resolve it.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman expressed his regret to those suffering from the ongoing fuel crisis in Bangladesh. Speaking at a discussion meeting on Saturday, he described the fuel shortage as the country's most significant current problem.

The event was held at the Bangladesh Agriculturalists Institute auditorium to mark the BNP's 48th anniversary. During his speech, the PM confirmed that a comprehensive action plan has been developed to address the energy shortage.

The Prime Minister also warned against those attempting to spread confusion regarding the problems inherited from the autocratic and interim periods. He stated that any acts of anarchy will be dealt with strictly.

Addressing political rivals, the BNP chairman questioned whether some 'hidden' elements are attempting to create chaos to bring back the autocratic regime. He urged all citizens to remain within their legal boundaries.
caption:
The fuel crisis is now the country's biggest problem. Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has expressed regret for the public's suffering.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman expressed his regret to those suffering from the ongoing fuel crisis in Bangladesh. Speaking at a discussion meeting on Saturday, he described the fuel shortage as the country's most significant current problem.

The event was held at the Bangladesh Agriculturalists Institute auditorium to mark the BNP's 48th anniversary. During his speech, the PM confirmed that a comprehensive action plan has been developed to address the energy shortage.

The Prime Minister also warned against those attempting to spread confusion regarding the problems inherited from the autocratic and interim periods. He stated that any acts of anarchy will be dealt with strictly.

Addressing political rivals, the BNP chairman questioned whether some 'hidden' elements are attempting to create chaos to bring back the autocratic regime. He urged all citizens to remain within their legal boundaries.

headline_marked: 988 hospitalizations in 24 hours: [[Two more die of dengue]]
headline: 988 hospitalizations in 24 hours: Two more die of dengue
summary: Total deaths this year have reached 113 as nearly 1,000 people were admitted to hospitals across Bangladesh in a single day.
details: According to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), two more people died of dengue in the last 24 hours. During the same period, 988 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country.

// Hospitalization breakdown by region: Barishal (170), Chattogram (123), Dhaka outside City Corporations (176), Dhaka North City Corporation (102), Dhaka South City Corporation (149), Khulna (163), Mymensingh (50), Rajshahi (49), and Rangpur (6).
This brings the total number of dengue-related hospitalizations for the current year to 41,032.
The total death toll from dengue in Bangladesh has now reached 113 people this year.
caption:
Nearly 1,000 people were hospitalized for dengue in just 24 hours. Two more lives lost.

According to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), two more people died of dengue in the last 24 hours. During the same period, 988 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country.

// Hospitalization breakdown by region: Barishal (170), Chattogram (123), Dhaka outside City Corporations (176), Dhaka North City Corporation (102), Dhaka South City Corporation (149), Khulna (163), Mymensingh (50), Rajshahi (49), and Rangpur (6).

This brings the total number of dengue-related hospitalizations for the current year to 41,032.

The total death toll from dengue in Bangladesh has now reached 113 people this year.
